faqs.question: What services does Luxora provide?
faqs.answer: Luxora provides an ultra-luxury concierge service across three core verticals: **Auto Care** (doorstep foam wash, vacuum, paint correction, interior leather conditioning), **Garden Care** (manicured lawn mowing, deep root hydration, organic fertilization, landscape styling), and **Pet Care** (hypoallergenic spa grooming, guided 45-min walks, and aquarium water testing/cleaning).

faqs.question: What packages are available and how much do they cost?
faqs.answer:
We offer three transparent monthly packages:

1. **Single Care - Auto Elite**: LKR 12,000 / month (Includes 2 Auto Care coins/sessions, dedicated KYC specialist, and 10% off add-on detailing).
2. **Single Care - Garden Oasis**: LKR 15,000 / month (Includes 4 Garden Care coins/sessions, monthly organic fertilizer, and landscape consultations).
3. **Luxora Tri-Combo Luxury Suite**: LKR 32,000 / month (Includes 8 total coins: 2 Auto, 4 Garden, and 2 Pet Care sessions, zero cancellation fees, and VIP concierge hotline access).

faqs.question: What is included in each package and how do coins/tokens work?
faqs.answer:
Each package awards monthly **Luxora Coins**. Exactly **1 Coin = 1 Service Session** in its respective category:

• **Auto Elite**: 2 Auto Coins (e.g. 2x Wash + Vacuum per month).
• **Garden Oasis**: 4 Garden Coins (e.g. weekly lawn mowing & plant health visits).
• **Tri-Combo Suite**: 8 Coins total (2 Auto, 4 Garden, 2 Pet sessions per month).

When you book a service on your dashboard, 1 coin is redeemed seamlessly upon confirmation.

faqs.question: How does booking work?
faqs.answer:
Booking is effortless:
1. Log in to your Luxora Customer Dashboard.
2. Choose your required service category.
3. Select your preferred date, time slot, and vehicle/estate address.
4. Confirm the booking with 1 service coin (or PayHere checkout if booking outside package allowance).
5. A verified KYC provider in your area is assigned immediately, with real-time arrival notifications.

faqs.question: How does cancellation and rescheduling work?
faqs.answer: You can cancel or reschedule any appointment with zero penalty up to **2 hours before** the booked time directly in your Customer Dashboard. The service coin is returned immediately to your active balance. Tri-Combo members enjoy free cancellation up until provider dispatch.

faqs.question: What happens if my requirements exceed standard package limits?
faqs.answer: If your residence requires additional visits, estate acreage beyond standard scope, fleet detailing, or bespoke tasks, you can submit a **Special Ask Service** request directly from your dashboard or this chat. Our concierge team personally assesses your property and provides a tailored solution.

faqs.question: How does a Special Ask Service work?
faqs.answer: **Special Ask Service is NOT an automated custom package.** If your request requires custom equipment, multiple concurrent teams, or non-standard hours, your inquiry is routed directly to the human Luxora Concierge Operations desk. We will review the requirements, inspect the scope, and provide an official quotation without automated guesswork.

faqs.question: How are service providers vetted and assigned?
faqs.answer: All Luxora specialists undergo comprehensive background checks, national identity verification (NIC KYC), and professional trade certification. Providers are assigned based on geographical proximity (e.g., Colombo municipal zones) and service specialization to ensure punctual, five-star execution.

faqs.question: What happens after I complete a booking?
faqs.answer: Once booked, you receive an instant confirmation on your dashboard and SMS/email. You will receive a notification when your specialist is dispatched, followed by GPS status. Upon completion, a digital service summary and checklist are posted to your account for your review and rating.
